findings.summary: The rig's fixed pointer drag now grabs and fires the pebble (fix verified: debug beacon pebbles 3→2→1 across the run, mid-HUD 'FLIGHT 1/3 · ✓ 0 · ♥ 2' after the first fire), but both fired pebbles missed every duck (flightHits 0 vs pass 2), so the blind driver lands on the loss overlay at t=19.0 of a 240s budget — a fixed down-left pull cannot lead a crossing duck, so win coverage for this pointer-skill genre stays structurally out of the rig's reach (loss recorded honestly).

Win-detection fix verified: the 'TRY AGAIN' overlay is now recorded as win:false with still-loss.png captured (the stale run mislabeled this same overlay win:true with verdictNote 'result overlay text did not clearly read as a win').

Driver edge phase never ran: pause (Escape), blur, refocus and mash are scheduled at 70–90% of the 240s budget (t≥168s) but the run ended at t=19.0 on the loss overlay — all 42 trace rows show pause:false and no pause/blur/mash keys, so pause/blur robustness, refocus recovery, button-mash and the audio toggles were never exercised for this level.

The generic rig cannot read this genre's debug state: window.__DUCK is exposed as { read: snapshot } but the probe only calls .state(), so every trace row records state:"{}" and pebbles/flightHits/ducksOnScreen progress is only recoverable by zooming the DOM beacon in the stills (still-loss.png crop shows flightHits:0, pebbles:1, flightTotal:3, pass:2, ducksOnScreen:0).

FTUE is discoverable — on-grass hint 'GRAB THE PEBBLE · DRAG BACK · RELEASE', intro banner ('THREE FLIGHTS, a duck-quota each…') and the bottom instruction bar are all legible in the stills — but the controls string is English-only (meta.controls, line 199; no FR variant exists anywhere in the module): genre modules carry EN-only controls per the checklist.

Top-left HUD contrast is poor at booth distance: the author credit ('Mark Abdallah', 11px var(--dim), index.html:37) and the 'LIVES' caption (9px var(--dim), index.html:39) render nearly invisible against the black HUD bar in still-pebble/still-laugh, while the mid HUD ('FLIGHT 1/3 · ✓ 0 · ♥ 3') and '★ 0' score read fine; the mid HUD also reuses the ♥ glyph for pebble ammo (slingshot.js:557) that the top-left uses for the cross-level lives bank — one glyph, two meanings, same bar.

Checklist positives verified: the lose path spends a cross-level heart ('♥ lost — 2 remaining' overlay = Save.spend(1) 3→2, HUD refreshed), and AUTOMNE is the default season (orange falling-leaf particles + warm tint visible in still-pebble at t=3.2; seasonNow() falls back to SEASONS.autumn).
